body:
**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `173a7af`: all 11 files reviewed.

5 finding(s): 2 to fix, 3 to consider; 5 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 2.** Part 1 has no findings. All ten files are documentation: two new ADRs, the ADR index, two new backlog pages, the backlog index, the sidebar config and cross-links in the webcam pages.

- **ADR 0033 is amended correctly.** 0039 amends decision 2 and the non-goal on animated layout transitions. 0033 only gains a status note pointing to 0039; its history is not rewritten, so it stays append-only.
- **0039 matches 0033.** It correctly says 0033's reopen condition (a scene where the webcam is the subject) did not trigger this change. Camera-only clips are left to the backlog, which matches that condition.
- **0040 matches 0033.** Its drawing order (zoom crop → framing → media lanes → camera) keeps 0033's rule that the camera is a viewport layer drawn after the zoom crop and the framing.
- **Links and status cells agree.** The ADR index rows, the backlog rows, the sidebar slugs and the cross-links all match the new pages.

**Batch 2 of 2.** I reviewed the editor timeline v2 design spec, part 2 and its only file. I found two things to fix. An acceptance criterion depends on a 0.6 s section, which the spec's own 1 s minimum rules out. The `webcamStateAt` duration formula mixes milliseconds and seconds. I also flagged three things to consider: the limit on open export inputs is stated three different ways, splitting a section can change the left half's transition length, and restoring a hidden media lane is not covered by the two-video limit. The ADR links and index entries for 0039 and 0040 match.

> ℹ️ No critical issues. Four places in the spec contradict themselves or leave a rule out. These lines seed tests, so fixing them now is cheap. **Reviewed changes** I reviewed the whole design: the timeline v2 spec, ADRs 0039 and 0040, the two backlog pages, and the index, sidebar and cross-reference edits. - **Camera sections (ADR 0039, spec §2)**: an `override` segment becomes a section that changes only position and size. It carries an optional Slide or Cut `transition` with CSS easing, capped at 50 % of the section. Hiding fades over 200 ms outside the hidden range. Everything is driven by one pure `webcamStateAt(webcam, t)`. - **Tracks on demand (ADR 0040, spec §3)**: `removedTracks` plus a `visibleScene` read by the preview and the export. Activity becomes marks inside Zooms. Detected zooms become suggestions and are no longer applied on open. - **Media lanes (ADR 0040, spec §4)**: timeline-anchored image and video items on stackable `mediaLanes`, composed after the zoom crop and below the camera. At most 2 visible videos and 8 images. - **Per-source audio and mixing (spec §5)**: one audio lane per media lane. `mixAudio` resamples to 48 kHz, sums and soft-clips. - **Session and reuse (spec §6–7)**: every new key is additive inside version 1. The composer revision goes `wc1 → wc2`, Share's whole fingerprint becomes `whole:wc2:`, and `md1` is added when media is present. - **Backlog and cross-references**: new pages for background music and camera-only clips, plus notes on ADR 0033, the webcam spec and `backlog/webcam-track.md`. The ADR number collisions with `main` are already called out in the PR body, so this review leaves them out.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/469?action=fix&review_id=5721904613) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/469?action=fix-approved&review_id=5721904613) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41182554950/job/124482762723) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)

> ℹ️ No critical issues. One note was lost in the merge, and there is a fix inline. **Reviewed changes** Since the last review, the only new commit merges the base branch and renumbers the webcam ADRs. - **Renumbered the webcam ADRs**: every link, description and table cell that cited 0032/0033 now cites 0037/0038. That covers ADRs 0039 and 0040, the spec's decision table and its "extends or reopens" list, `camera-only-clips.md` and both index tables. A grep of the docs tree turns up no stale `0032-webcam` or `0033-webcam` links. - **Merged main's ADR and backlog rows**: the ADR index gained 0032–0036 (workspaces, rename, reconcile), and the backlog table gained the rename and workspaces rows above this PR's three rows.
